title: Amelioration of oxidative stress mediated inflammation and apoptosis in pancreatic islets by Lupeol in STZ-induced hyperglycaemic mice.
authors: Das, Abhishek Kumar; Hossain, Uday; Ghosh, Sumit; Biswas, Sima; Mandal, Mullicka; Mandal, Bhagirath; Brahmachari, Goutam; Bagchi, Angshuman; Sil, Parames C
one_liner_zh: 该文研究羽扇豆醇在STZ诱导高血糖小鼠中缓解胰岛氧化应激、炎症和凋亡的分子机制，属于纯湿实验药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Type 1 Diabetes mellitus initiates by loss of pancreatic activity which affects other major organs leading to multi-organ failure. Lupeol, a novel phytochemical, is emerging as a potent bioactive molecule. However, the effect of lupeol on hyperglycaemia is not clearly understood. This study delivers an elaborate vision towards the detailed molecular pathway of lupeol against STZ induced diabetic difficulties of the pancreas. METHOD: The current experiments were designed to focus on the ameliorative effect of the triterpene in combating oxidative damage on the pancreas in a preclinical streptozotocin induced mouse model. After diabetic induction, the animals were subjected to administration with 75 mg kg(-1) body weight of lupeol, thrice a week for 7 weeks. Histological measurements were done to investigate the anatomy of the pancreas as well as molecular mechanisms were explored. RESULTS: The compound was found to regulate several hyperglycaemic and oxidative stress related markers. Lupeol treatment also reversed the expression levels of inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha and IL-1beta) as well as attenuated the NF-kappaB mediated inflammatory and extrinsic apoptotic pathway. DISCUSSION: These findings in preclinical streptozotocin induced in vivo mouse model strongly suggest the discovery of novel properties of lupeol against oxidative stress in pancreatic beta cells by regulating the NF-kappaB and extrinsic apoptotic pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：1型糖尿病始于胰腺活性丧失，进而影响其他主要器官，导致多器官衰竭。羽扇豆醇（Lupeol）作为一种新型植物化学物质，正逐渐显现为有效的生物活性分子。然而，羽扇豆醇对高血糖症的作用尚未被明确理解。本研究提供了羽扇豆醇对抗链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导的胰腺糖尿病并发症的详细分子通路的深入视角。方法：当前实验设计旨在聚焦于三萜类化合物在临床前链脲佐菌素诱导的小鼠模型中对抗胰腺氧化损伤的改善作用。糖尿病诱导后，动物接受75 mg kg(-1)体重的羽扇豆醇给药，每周三次，持续7周。进行组织学测量以考察胰腺解剖结构，并探索分子机制。结果：发现该化合物能调节多种高血糖和氧化应激相关标志物。羽扇豆醇处理还逆转了炎症细胞因子（TNF-α和IL-1β）的表达水平，并减弱了NF-κB介导的炎症和外源性凋亡通路。讨论：这些在临床前链脲佐菌素诱导的体内小鼠模型中的发现强烈提示，羽扇豆醇通过调节NF-κB和外源性凋亡通路，在胰腺β细胞中对抗氧化应激方面具有新发现的特性。
